pendingWork.result: Executed on the local MySQL 8 against an isolated scratch schema (pantheon_ops_ra); the pantheon_ops dev database was never written and docker-compose.yml was deliberately not used (3306 collision plus the deprecated database/system_init.sql mount). golang-migrate over the embedded backend/pkg/database/migrations set reached schema_migrations version=30 dirty=false with 34 tables on an empty schema. go run ./cmd/server with PANTHEON_AUTO_MIGRATE=true then listened on 8080 with no panic or fatal, finished its maintenance tasks and grew the schema to 81 tables across the 22 business-domain AutoMigrate sites, seeding 228 menus, 4 active tenant plans (free/basic/professional/enterprise), 84 settings, 1385 i18n rows, the admin user and roles. The tenant console was exercised over its real HTTP contract: login through the cookie jar (access, refresh and csrf), then user/info, tenant/list, tenant-ops/plan/list, tenant-ops/overview and tenant-ops/member all 200 in compat mode; after flipping platform.tenant_mode to multi in the scratch schema (5s ModeLoader TTL, no restart) the full write lifecycle ran - create with tenant-admin provisioning, get, members, overview, archive, the first delete refused with auth.operation.verification_required by the secure-action guard, re-verified through /auth/operation-verify, then deleted, leaving total=0 and the soft-deleted __deleted_tenant_1 row. go test -count=1 ./modules/system/iam/tenant/ ./modules/platform/ passed uncached. The one-off driver was deleted; the scratch schema is left in place for inspection.

notes: v0.18.1 is a patch on top of the 13-wave simplification minor: base commit 93505225 is the squash merge of base PR #469, the tag object b639743 is annotated, and the four assets were re-hashed locally after materialization and matched both the lock and their own sidecars. Release Gate run 40814653285 and Foundation Release Verify run 40817118092 are both success on the tagged commit, and every other base workflow on that commit is success. The consumer had to move for a real reason rather than for parity: v0.18.0's simplification wave removed the isForbiddenRequestError export from frontend/src/api/request.ts on a repo-local zero-caller search, and the ops DeployTaskDetail page still imported it, so the consumer frontend build failed with TS2614. v0.18.1 restores the export. The swap itself also surfaced three consumer-side drifts that base 0.18 tightened: the stale scripts/task-manifest.mjs overlay that lacked resolveArchiveAwarePath, the missing check:ui-quality-gate workflow step, and the complete status spelling in 11 manifests.
